static_traits.name: Li Man
static_traits.social_status: 在瑞典有少量朋友，但not yet与其讨论健忘问题
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；既往without类似问题与心理治疗史
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑性较好、语速平稳、能具体举例、态度积极、配合度高，伴随一定Anxiety

basic_info.main_problem: I often feel that I am losing things, and recently forgetfulness and disorganization problems have appeared in daily life. This problem began to appear a few months ago after moving to Sweden, and has now developed into frequently misplacing important items and forgetting tasks, occurring every day when under high pressure or busy.
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询是因为健忘和缺乏条理开始影响我的日常功能和Interpersonal relationships。
growth_experiences: 几个月前搬到瑞典，因跨国家搬迁感到overwhelmed（初期压力为中等）。搬迁后逐渐出现健忘与组织混乱：经常丢失物品、忘记任务、错过约会，问题频率在忙碌与高压情境中更明显。此前not yet有类似问题或心理治疗史，without重大身体疾病。搬迁后Work performance affected、与朋友和同事的关系受挫、日常生活更加混乱与Increased stress；虽在瑞典有少数朋友可谈日常，但not yet向他们谈及健忘问题。

core_beliefs: 我是一个缺乏条理、容易出错的人
如果not做到井井有条，就会被视为not可靠

special_situations.event: During busy and high-pressure periods at work or in life, needing to handle multiple tasks simultaneously
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 我必须把所有东西立刻放回原处、严格遵守规则，否则就会出错并被证明我not可靠
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复自我提醒“应该把东西放回原处”，尝试设定固定放置点与use提醒，但执行not稳定
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果这次not放回原处，我肯定又会把它弄丢

special_situations.event: 在工作中面对重要任务与截止日期
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要有一次忘记任务，do not人就会觉得我not专业、not可依赖
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 过度担心、独自扛下问题而not寻求同事或朋友支持，增加Self-monitoring

special_situations.event: 出门前或临近预约时发现自己找not到钥匙或重要物品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只要丢过一次东西，就说明我总是会丢东西
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 反复检查与拖延出门，以期减少出错

special_situations.event: Adaptation pressure from the new environment and new systems after moving to Sweden
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: I must adapt completely right away and stay perfectly organized, otherwise life and work will collapse
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Forces oneself to quickly establish a whole set of rules and habits, but finds them hard to maintain due to excessive load
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 如果我适应not好，我的生活和工作会一团糟

core_conflict.wish: 渴望保持掌控与有序，被他人视为可靠并Gaining recognition
core_conflict.fear: 担心被评价为not可靠而被指责、排斥或失去机会
defense_goal: 通过内化严格规则并加强自我控制来降低Anxiety
避免求助以防暴露自己的“not可靠”
以理性化方式聚焦方案而回避羞耻与without助感

object_relations.self_representation: 容易出错、需要not断自我约束的个体
object_relations.object_representation: 随时评判与挑剔可靠性的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当被询问情绪影响或人际受损细节时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 感觉自己会被当作not可靠的人而被评判（移情：将他人视为挑剔的评判者）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 语气温和稳定，先Empathy其压力与羞耻感，再用开放式问题温柔探询具体感受；放慢节奏、允许停顿，避免快速给建议以免加剧其自我批评。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When many self-demands of 'I should/must...' appear
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为只有严格遵从内在规则才能避免被negate（移情：把外界标准内化为内在评判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以接纳的语气邀请觉察“应该”的来源，区分外在标准与自我需要；use温和的重述与正常化，鼓励以“我需要/我选择”替代“我应该”。

manifestations: 跨国搬迁到瑞典后适应压力大
仅有少量朋友，且not yet与他们讨论健忘问题
在高压与忙碌情境中倾向独自承担
outcomes: 日常生活混乱与压力上升

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该把东西放回原处”等自我指令
将完美有序视为必须达成的标准

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 过度自我批评，担心被视为not可靠
倾向独自应对而not向朋友求助
在高压时进一步加大自我要求

positive_force: 态度积极，愿意求助并参与问题解决训练
能具体描述问题情境并提出可行步骤（设定固定放置点、use提醒、日程回顾）
具备一定社会支持（在瑞典有几位朋友）
对建立习惯与一致性持开放态度
negative_force: 跨国搬迁导致适应压力与环境变化
在忙碌与高压时执行功能负荷过大，健忘与without序加重
以“应该”为核心的自我苛责与完美化要求
回避求助、倾向独自承担，资源动员not足
缺乏稳定的一致性执行与情境化策略

target_behavior.behavior: Forgetfulness and disorganization (often misplacing items, forgetting tasks, being late)
antecedent: 搬到瑞典后的新环境与制度变化
高压力或忙碌、多任务情境
临近截止日期或约会时间
缺乏固定放置点与一致性习惯
target_behavior.core_reason: Changes of environment and role bring pressure to adapt, leading to scattered attention and a rise in executive-function load; internal 'should' rules increase self-pressure, and instead weaken the formation and maintenance of stable habits
target_behavior.function: 在高压下被动地减少当下的认知负荷与not适（逃避高负荷任务/决策压力），但非有意为之
target_behavior.consequence: Work performance affected、Interpersonal tension、日常生活混乱与压力上升
